notes:
Saying 'but not too much' no longer reverses what you asked for.

'speed it up but not too fast' was slowing the clip down. 'make it darker but not too dark' was brightening it. The qualifier limits how far to go, not which way — it now leaves the main verb to decide.

Also: 'not so bright', 'make it less loud' and 'a bit less fast' used to reach nothing at all, while 'too bright', 'too loud' and 'too fast' worked fine. Same complaint, so they work the same now.
